versions.content: Modeling of a Variable-Size Array Data Type with Size Indicator enabled An ImplementationDataType with category STRUCTURE where the attribute ImplementationDataType . dynamicArray- SizeProfile exists represents a Variable-Size Array Data Type with Size Indicator enabled. For the sake of a proper definition of terminology, this ImplementationDataType shall be called the VSA ImplementationDataType .
